models.name: RuntimeHealthResponse
models.description: Runtime health snapshot including metrics and event drop counters.

fields.name: metricsEnabled
fields.description: Whether SDK metrics collection is enabled for this session.

fields.name: stateCode
fields.description: Numeric SDK state code used by lower-level FFI state calls.

fields.name: rawSubscriberDroppedTotal
fields.description: Total raw subscriber events dropped because bounded queues were full.

fields.name: metricsJson
fields.description: JSON string for the metrics snapshot containing counters, gauges, and histograms.
